# Team Member Onboarding Checklist

## Purpose
Ensure new team members understand their role, responsibilities, and how to collaborate effectively within the OctoAcme project management framework.

---

## General Onboarding (All Roles)

### Week 1: Orientation & Access
- [ ] Complete company-wide onboarding
- [ ] Set up development environment (if applicable)
- [ ] Gain access to key systems:
  - [ ] GitHub repository and project board
  - [ ] Communication channels (Slack, Teams, etc.)
  - [ ] Documentation and knowledge base
  - [ ] CI/CD and deployment systems (as appropriate)
- [ ] Review OctoAcme project management documentation:
  - [ ] [Project Management Overview](../octoacme-project-management-overview.md)
  - [ ] [Roles & Personas](../octoacme-roles-and-personas.md)
  - [ ] [Role Responsibility Matrix](role-responsibility-matrix.md)
- [ ] Meet your manager and understand performance expectations
- [ ] Identify your onboarding buddy

### Week 2: Team Integration
- [ ] Attend daily standups
- [ ] Meet all team members in one-on-ones
- [ ] Understand current sprint/iteration goals
- [ ] Review project charter and product roadmap
- [ ] Shadow relevant meetings and ceremonies
- [ ] Begin small, well-defined tasks

### Week 3-4: Ramp Up
- [ ] Take ownership of tasks in your area
- [ ] Participate actively in team ceremonies
- [ ] Ask questions and provide feedback
- [ ] Complete role-specific onboarding (see below)

---

## Role-Specific Onboarding

### For Product Owners
- [ ] Review product vision and strategy with Product Manager
- [ ] Understand stakeholder landscape and communication cadence
- [ ] Review current product backlog and prioritization criteria
- [ ] Shadow sprint planning and backlog refinement sessions
- [ ] Learn about user personas and customer research
- [ ] Review product analytics and success metrics
- [ ] Conduct stakeholder introductions with PM support

### For Scrum Masters
- [ ] Review team norms, DoD, and sprint cadence
- [ ] Understand team dynamics and any current challenges
- [ ] Shadow existing Scrum Master (if applicable)
- [ ] Review retrospective history and ongoing improvement actions
- [ ] Learn escalation paths and cross-team dependencies
- [ ] Facilitate your first daily standup with support
- [ ] Meet with other Scrum Masters to share best practices

### For Developers
- [ ] Set up local development environment
- [ ] Review codebase architecture and coding standards
- [ ] Complete a small code contribution (fix a bug, small feature)
- [ ] Participate in code reviews
- [ ] Run tests locally and understand CI/CD pipeline
- [ ] Review security scanning and quality gates
- [ ] Pair program with experienced team member
- [ ] Understand branching strategy and PR workflow

### For UX/UI Designers
- [ ] Review design system and style guide
- [ ] Understand user personas and research findings
- [ ] Access design tools (Figma, Sketch, etc.)
- [ ] Review previous design work and rationale
- [ ] Shadow user research or usability testing session
- [ ] Present a small design to the team for feedback
- [ ] Understand handoff process with developers
- [ ] Learn accessibility standards and requirements

### For QA Leads
- [ ] Review test strategy and current test coverage
- [ ] Understand QA tooling and test automation framework
- [ ] Access test environments and test data
- [ ] Review defect tracking and triage process
- [ ] Shadow or participate in test plan review
- [ ] Execute manual test cases for current sprint
- [ ] Understand release criteria and quality gates
- [ ] Meet with developers to discuss testability

### For DevOps Engineers
- [ ] Review infrastructure architecture and IaC repositories
- [ ] Gain access to cloud platforms and deployment tools
- [ ] Understand CI/CD pipeline configuration
- [ ] Review monitoring, logging, and alerting setup
- [ ] Understand on-call rotation and incident response
- [ ] Shadow a deployment to production
- [ ] Review security scanning tools and policies
- [ ] Learn about disaster recovery and backup procedures

### For Product Managers
- [ ] Review product vision, strategy, and roadmap
- [ ] Understand market landscape and competitive analysis
- [ ] Review customer feedback and user research
- [ ] Access product analytics and business metrics
- [ ] Meet key stakeholders across the organization
- [ ] Shadow customer interviews or research sessions
- [ ] Review previous product decisions and outcomes
- [ ] Understand go-to-market and launch processes

### For Project Managers
- [ ] Review project charter and current status
- [ ] Understand resource allocation and timeline
- [ ] Access project management tools and dashboards
- [ ] Review risk register and mitigation plans
- [ ] Understand stakeholder communication cadence
- [ ] Shadow weekly status meetings
- [ ] Review previous project retrospectives
- [ ] Learn escalation paths and decision-making processes

---

## 30-Day Check-in

After 30 days, schedule a check-in with your manager to discuss:
- [ ] What's going well
- [ ] What's unclear or needs more support
- [ ] Action items to improve onboarding for future team members
- [ ] Goals for next 30-60 days
